not_claimed: No external users, feedback, business impact, production deployment, or GitHub stars are claimed.

resume_safe_summary: Published an external evidence triage board across 15 evaluated public issues, 0 accepted evidence items, 15 rejected issue checks, 5 waiting reviewer sends, and 0 claimable external-outcome resume lines.
